---
name: Interoperability report
about: Two devices that don't understand each other, or tones a receiver misses
title: "Interop: "
labels: interop
---

**Sender.** Device or software and its ur-tones version; pace (tone/gap ms).

**Receiver.** Device or software and its ur-tones version; sample rate.

**Between them.** Cable (which one, levels) or air (distance, room, noise).

**What happened.** Nothing heard / wrong tones / frames not repaired /
the wrong data.

**The recording.** Attach a WAV of what the receiver heard (the web tool:
*Listen → Record what is heard*).

<!-- TEST SEEDS AND TESTNET PSBTs ONLY: a recording of a real seed is a copy of it. -->
